integrity: The included programs and complete representatives certificate reproduce all enumerated smooth orbits and weighted distributions with exact algebraic smoothness testing.
scientific_limitations: An exact computational classification for sections of the fixed nonsplit quadric in characteristic two; no claim of a classification of abstract genus-four curves. Earlier models might imply some numbers after additional incidence computations; absolute bibliographic novelty and independent external verification remain open.
title: Rational theta-hyperplanes of genus-four curves on the nonsplit quadric over \(\mathbf F_2\)
